name: trend-weight-half-current-config
rationale: Lead #1 of the 2026-10-19 report. On that run trend-weight-half (TREND_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT 0.25 -> 0.5) was a near-miss at 50k (Sharpe +2.30 vs baseline, rejected only on +0.91 pp drawdown) and, against its own zone-0.2/0.8 config control, lifted 50k Sharpe from -15.53 to -10.10 and 500k Sharpe from -47.6 to -28.4. But its trading_config carried the stale zone 0.2/0.8, so its delta mixed the weight change with a zone change. This re-runs exactly the same one-constant change on experiments/baseline-config.json as it stands after PR #34 (zone 0.1/0.9, MACD 52/104/18), isolating the weight effect.
code_change_summary: In TradingEngine::compute_btc_target (src/trading/engine.rs), change the single constant TREND_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT from 0.25 to 0.5, leaving REVERSION_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT at 1.0. Nothing else changes: every sub-signal formula (RSI, damped SMA cross, damped EMA cross, damped MACD histogram, Bollinger %B), the weighted-mean aggregation ta_normalized = sum(value*weight)/sum(weight), the empty-sub_signals warmup guard returning None, the non-positive SMA/EMA guards, the MACD bb_middle fallback and the sentiment combination all stay byte-for-byte identical. Update the constant's doc comment to record that 0.5 is a midpoint probe between the merged 0.25 and the rejected trend-dominant 1.0, and to cite the 2026-10-19 near-miss and the re-measured lag-1 autocorrelation of -0.0146 on 1-minute bitFlyer returns over the pre-holdout training window (2026-08-09 -> 2026-08-26, 18,648 bars) rather than the superseded -0.028 hourly CoinGecko figure. Then update the expected values in the compute_btc_target_* unit tests in src/trading/engine.rs's test module wherever the new weight legitimately changes them -- verify which are affected by running the tests rather than assuming; the existing comment in compute_btc_target_strong_buy_returns_target_above_half spells out its arithmetic ((0.8*1.0 + 1.0*0.25)/1.25 = 0.84) and will need recomputing for weight 0.5.
constraints: This hypothesis modifies the body of TradingEngine::compute_btc_target. This change MUST be made only on this hypothesis's own dedicated isolation: "worktree" branch -- never as a direct commit to dev/main.
MUST NOT change TradingEngine::compute_btc_target's signature (its parameter list or return type) -- only its body.
MUST NOT change any individual sub-signal's own formula, the aggregation expression, or REVERSION_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT; exactly one numeric constant changes.

MUST pass `cargo test`, including the compute_btc_target_* unit tests in src/trading/engine.rs -- update their expected values if the new weight legitimately changes them (do not weaken or delete a test just to make it pass).

A promoted change still becomes its own PR against dev (per the pipeline's step 6) and is never merged automatically -- a human reviews it like any other algorithm hypothesis. Flag explicitly in the PR description that this diff touches compute_btc_target's body, so the reviewer gives it the scrutiny an allocation-formula change deserves.
MUST NOT touch src/exchange/bitflyer/*, .github/workflows/*, or anything on the live order-submission path.
